page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g5ne.8xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance based on the KVM hypervisor. It features 32 dedicated vCPUs mapped from 16 physical cores of an Intel Xeon 8163 processor running at 2.5 GHz. The instance is equipped with 128.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB of RAM per physical core. It does not include local storage or GPU accelerators, relying entirely on network-attached storage. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 15 Gbps.

Benchmark data indicates a clear performance divergence between single-core and multi-core operations. Single-core performance is weak, with stress-ng single-core CPU, Geekbench single-core, and bzip3 single-threaded decompression scores falling into the bottom 25%, while single-threaded gzip compression registers in the bottom 10%. Conversely, multi-core execution scales to average levels, as demonstrated by middle-tier scores in stress-ng multi-core, Geekbench multi-core, and Passmark CPU tests. Memory bandwidth for both small and large blocks remains in the average range, though the Passmark memory score is weak.

The instance is suited for workloads that can leverage parallel processing to offset the lower single-core performance. Appropriate applications include static web serving, multi-threaded software compilation, and database operations, which all achieved average benchmark ratings. It can also handle moderate LLM inference tasks using small to medium models. From a cost-efficiency perspective, the hardware profile offers a balanced resource density of compute and memory, making it a viable option for multi-threaded enterprise applications that do not require high-speed local storage or GPU acceleration.
